_help: Drives the 'This Saturday's Review' block inside the Study Saturday livestream card on community.html, AND the 'Discovery — Read Together' card just above it. The entry in 'weeks' whose 'weekOf' date is today-or-earlier AND closest to today is rendered. Add a new entry each week. 'weekOf' format: YYYY-MM-DD (Monday of the week by convention). Fields: oldTestament + newTestament (Saturday review block — optional, if neither is set the review block is hidden); anchorChapter (the chapter life groups read together that week — used by the Discovery card on community.html, optional, falls back to a generic prompt if unset); anchorNote (optional one-line italic note shown under the chapter name — context, theme, why this chapter matters this week).
